{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows and dtypes
sales.info()

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:", (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check unique customer_segment values
print("\nUnique customer segments:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())"}
